title: Conditional computation time
statement: Let $D,M_1,M_2$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $p$ map Boolean words to Booleans, and let $f_1,f_2$ map Boolean words to Boolean words. Suppose $D$ computes $[p(x)]$ on every input $x$ in exactly $T_0(|x|)$ steps, and $M_1,M_2$ compute $f_1(x),f_2(x)$ in exactly $T_1(|x|),T_2(|x|)$ steps, respectively. Then the conditional machine computes $f_1(x)$ when $p(x)$ is true and $f_2(x)$ when $p(x)$ is false, on every input $x$, in exactly $5\bigl(T_0(|x|)+\max(T_1(|x|),T_2(|x|))+1\bigr)$ steps.
